images.prompt:
Korean webtoon panel, digitally inked and coloured by a professional webtoon studio. Crisp black ink with tapered strokes, heavier on the outer silhouette, the jaw, the hair mass and where forms overlap. Flat local colour with one hard-edged cool cel shadow per material. One named key light: its colour washes smoothly over the lit side. If the scene names a back light, it draws a thin crisp rim along the figure's silhouette. Everything else stays flat. Muted cool base palette of slate, navy and grey-blue, so the light source and the character's signature colour carry the saturation. Background simplified and lower in contrast than the characters. Small crisp highlights; glossy specular only on metal and wet surfaces.
Hand-made webtoon colouring: each garment has only a few large, opaque, clean-edged shadow shapes, placed in its real folds; no scattered translucent streaks, zigzag shards or crumpled-foil folds. Worn cloth shows a few small frayed notches and loose threads, never sawtooth edges along every edge. Plain shoes and clothes with no logos, stripes or brand marks. Every strap, buckle, pocket and seam is attached and has a purpose; no stray stitch marks. Matte skin, hair and stone; no 3D, low-poly or plastic look.
Use case: illustration-story. Asset: L19 farm_drains/key.png, a full-detail environment establishing key. One native landscape 1536x1024 PNG. The approved sewer key is a reference for hand-inked wet stone, caged white-blue lamps and comic cel colouring ONLY; this new place is NOT the old brick sewer.
Inside the core farm's OLD FAR SIDE TIDE CHANNELS: a ROUND STONE TUNNEL exactly 5 m in diameter, climbing in a long switchback toward the gate rim. Large grey-blue stone voussoirs form distinct closely spaced transverse arch ribs. Each arch has ONE central carved keystone at its crown: a simple geometric wave or shell RELIEF, not writing. The round wall continues under the water. The first rising run curves sharply to the LEFT in the middle distance, and beyond its opening a higher returning run turns back uphill, making the switchback direction legible. Keep the roof INTACT with a few age cracks, no collapse or combat damage.
Camera at 1.7 m above the RIGHT-HAND narrow grated steel walkway, looking upward along the climbing channel; three-quarter view with the near right rail cropped into foreground. The steel walkway is 1.0 m wide and slopes uphill with the tunnel; safety rail is 1.1 m high, brackets connect it firmly to the wall. It stays continuous round the bend. On the LEFT is the lower channel of surging black water, visibly being pumped UPHILL; a squat cast-iron pump housing is bolted beside it in the near left middle ground with a rigid discharge pipe pointing into the rising flow. Another pump is farther up at the bend. All fittings are connected and serviceable. No giant horizontal pipes filling the tunnel. Cold-white caged lamps attached to alternating arch piers illuminate the carved keystones, walkway and wet ripple edges. Deep violet-grey ambient from the distant pit below.
Exactly TWO tiny generic adult workers on the middle-distance RIGHT walkway for scale, about 1.7 m each, grey coveralls, unmarked dull-orange tabards, white hard hats. No letters, numbers or facial detail. They must remain 7.5 heads tall with adult leg lengths and grounded feet, walking uphill one behind the other, not side-by-side mannequins. At their depth the 5 m tunnel crown stands almost three times their height above the low channel floor. Every figure and arch shares one camera and floor plane. No other people or creatures.
Light and style: visible white-blue caged lamps, hard cool cel shadows in slate and violet, clean broad opaque shapes, selected ink cracks and damp stains, matte stone. Wet water and steel have restrained crisp highlights. Brightest lamps stay localized; no fog, bloom, depth blur or photographic textures. Full detail on the location, lower-contrast far bend, still crisp. No text, no system lights or alarms.
No text, letters, numbers, speech bubbles, captions, sound-effect lettering, interface windows or readable signs. Emblems without letters are fine; no brand logos or wordmarks. Not a 3D render, not a photograph, no photographic background. No airbrushed skin, no plastic gloss on skin or hair, no haze or bloom over the whole image, no depth-of-field blur, no lens flare unless a real camera flash is in the scene. No watermark or signature. Correct hands with five fingers. No chibi proportions unless the brief says chibi. No compressed or stubby bodies, no shortened legs or torsos, no oversized heads; no people out of scale with the doors, vehicles and buildings around them; no figures floating off the floor or breaking the scene's perspective.
references: locations_v2/sewer_gate/key.png (approved L6; style and lamp material only)
review: Kept: climbing round stone channel, carved keystones, continuous right walkway, pumps and two grounded scale figures.
